provenance.recordedRefusal: phase 2 of 5: implementer body refused: no fence, and the text from the first '{' (offset 0) to the end of the body is not valid JSON: Bad control character in string literal in JSON at position 112141 (line 1 column 112142)
provenance.whatThisRecords: The implementer's whole response to one phase dispatch: a complete AgentResult with status proposed and one patch of 11 files, finished normally (end_turn, is_error false). Exactly one raw line break (U+000A) sits inside a JSON string, in the content of src/server/routes/import.ts at line 605 of 649, after 'processZip(config, md, file, notes, rejected);' and before '} else if (ext === ...'. Every other line break in the response is escaped as backslash-n.
provenance.provesWhat: A model can emit one unescaped line break in a 113,649-character JSON response; the strict parse refuses it at that offset. It shows the slip was a single character at 98.7 percent of the way through, and that replacing that one character with backslash-n yields a parseable AgentResult. It does not show how often this happens.
provenance.droppedFromEnvelope: The retained stream (2.4 MB: system, stream_event, assistant and user lines for seven turns) is dropped. Only the final result line's result text and its numeric fields are kept. session_id, uuid and per-request timing fields are dropped.
provenance.sanitized: The result text was checked for absolute machine paths, user names and key material before commit; none found.
